notes: V2 extraction from the original source image. This pass removes the residual magenta edge contamination found in the first WebP output.

assets.imagegen_prompt: Extraction mode: preserve the supplied hero image exactly and remove only the magenta chroma-key background, including anti-aliased magenta edge residue, to produce a transparent standalone hero asset.
assets.extraction_method: Border-connected magenta chroma key, one-pixel mask expansion, transparent/partial-edge inpaint despill, ImageMagick trim, and ImageMagick WebP export at quality 94.
